ten: Mo lenh doi ung sau N lenh (hedge khi sau)
mo_ta: Khi mot chuoi co N lenh (CCBSN: 5-12), mo them lenh NGUOC chieu voi lot nho co dinh (0,01-0,05) de giam toc do am.
vet: Co lenh nguoc chieu xuat hien dung khi so lenh cua chuoi doi dien dat so co dinh; lot nho va khong tang.

engine.ghi_chu: luoi.py hai chuoi chay roi nhau, khong co lenh doi ung trong cung chuoi.

ap_cheo: Khoi nen thu SOM vi CCBSN song sot dung no; do bang quet_luoi sau khi them.
rui_ro: Hedge khong dong: neu khong co luat dong, hai chieu cung ket.
bang_chung_ghi_chu: chua co (the moi gieo, chua do)
